name: band front lateral raise
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with both hands and lift your arms straight out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground. Lower and repeat.

name: band front raise
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with both hands and lift your arms straight out in front of you until they are parallel to the ground. Lower and repeat.

name: band reverse fly
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Bend over at the waist and grasp the band with both hands. Pull your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground. Lower and repeat.

name: band shoulder press
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with both hands at shoulder height. Press the band overhead until your arms are fully extended. Lower and repeat.

name: band standing rear delt row
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with both hands and pull your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower and repeat.

name: band twisting overhead press
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with both hands at shoulder height. Press the band overhead while twisting your torso to one side. Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: band y-raise
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under your feet. Grasp the band with both hands and lift your arms into a 'Y' shape until they are parallel to the ground. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell front raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip. Lift the barbell straight out in front of you until your arms are parallel to the ground. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell one arm snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with one hand. Quickly lift the barbell overhead in one motion. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell rear delt raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip. Bend over at the waist and lift the barbell out to the sides until your arms are parallel to the ground. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell rear delt row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip. Bend over at the waist and pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell seated behind head military press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a barbell held behind your head. Press the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell seated bradford rocky press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a barbell held at shoulder height. Press the barbell overhead and lower it behind your head. Press it overhead again and lower it in front of your head. Repeat.

name: barbell seated overhead press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a barbell held at shoulder height. Press the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell skier
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with both hands. Swing the barbell forward and backward in a controlled motion. Repeat.

name: barbell standing bradford press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell at shoulder height. Press the barbell overhead and lower it behind your head. Press it overhead again and lower it in front of your head. Repeat.

name: barbell standing close grip military press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with a close grip. Press the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell standing front raise over head
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip. Lift the barbell straight out in front of you until it is overhead. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell standing wide military press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with a wide grip. Press the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell thruster
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell at shoulder height. Lower into a squat and then quickly press the barbell overhead as you stand up. Lower and repeat.

name: barbell upright row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip. Lift the barbell straight up to your chest, keeping your elbows high. Lower and repeat.
